stories.title: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
stories.summary: Travel plans for multiple sports have been disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

stories.title: Ole Miss-Oklahoma bumped to Sunday despite Sooners AD's 'strong objection'
stories.summary: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny was critical of the SEC's decision to move the Sooners' home game against Ole Miss to Sunday following Friday's nationwide ground stop.

stories.title: First Cousins: QB to get start vs. Packers in Vikings return
stories.summary: Coach Kevin O'Connell called Kirk Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the Vikings' offense "impressive."

stories.title: Sources: Tide to start QB Mack vs. Vandy; injured Russell available, if needed
stories.summary: Alabama is expected to start QB Austin Mack vs. Vanderbilt, sources told ESPN, with starter Keelon Russell (ankle) expected to be available, if needed.

stories.title: Giannis, Bam combine for 74 as Heat flex potential as East contenders
stories.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo each scored 37 points to help the Heat top the Cavs for their sixth win in eight games.
